strategy.overview: Complete the left Lock target sequence, then shoot the top-right hole to capture the first ball. On the next plunge, send the served ball into that same top-right hole to lock it and start three-ball Multiball; if the plunge misses, two-ball Multiball begins instead. The five movie Scenes build toward Select-a-Feature at the same hole.
strategy.simpleOverview: Complete the left Lock targets and shoot the top-right hole to capture a ball. Plunge the next ball into that same hole for three-ball Multiball; a missed plunge starts two-ball Multiball. Start Gunfight at the flashing top-left hole, or complete all five Scenes and shoot the top-right hole for Select-a-Feature.
strategy.summary: Complete the left Lock targets and lock one ball at the top-right hole. Plunge the next ball into that hole for three-ball Multiball; a miss starts two-ball play. Start Gunfight at the flashing top-left hole and finish all five Scenes for Select-a-Feature.

quickInfo.name: Light Lock
quickInfo.summary: Complete the left Lock target sequence.

quickInfo.name: Start Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Lock at the top-right hole, then plunge the next ball into the same hole for three balls; a miss gives two.

quickInfo.name: Start Gunfight
quickInfo.summary: Shoot the flashing top-left hole, then press the right flipper on DRAW.

quickInfo.name: Start Select-a-Feature
quickInfo.summary: Complete all five Scenes, then shoot the top-right hole.

steps.text: Complete the left Lock target sequence to light Lock at the top-right hole.
Shoot the top-right hole to capture the first ball.
On the next plunge, send the served ball into the top-right hole to lock it and start three-ball Multiball.
If the plunge misses the hole, continue with the two-ball Multiball that starts instead.

alternatives.title: Start Gunfight
alternatives.when: Use this when the top-left hole is flashing for Gunfight.

steps.text: Shoot the top-left hole to start Gunfight.
Wait for DRAW, then press the right flipper button to fire.

alternatives.title: Complete the five Scenes
alternatives.when: Use these routes to reach Select-a-Feature.

steps.text: For Stair Scene, light SPIN, shoot the spinner, then use the top-right hole to transfer each lit card; collect all five cards.
For Jackpot Scene, clear the center drop bank, then advance the exposed center target to Collect Jackpot.
For Stunt Scene, clear the right drop bank, hit the top-left target, then finish the flashing targets.
After all five Scenes, shoot the top-right hole; cycle with the right flipper and select with the left.
Use the Scene inserts to see which movie sequences remain.
Prioritize the physical task for an unfinished Scene rather than repeating a completed one.
Once all five are complete, return to the top-right hole for Select-a-Feature.

machineSetup: Confirm Multiball, Extra Ball, Special, and timed-feature settings before competitive play.
Test the left Lock targets, top-right capture hole, shooter-lane feed, top-left Gunfight hole, both drop banks, spinner, card inserts, and flipper-button selections.

cautions.issue: The second plunge determines whether Multiball begins with three balls or two.
cautions.response: Aim for the top-right hole on the plunge; if it misses, switch immediately to controlled two-ball play.
